changes_summary: Recorded broad homelabber audience, primary public HTTPS with supported mode/settings choice, and manager-only production Compose connected to existing Caddy. Resolved answered Q1/Q3 and primary Q2; acceptance now uses a reproducible reference service and separate Caddy test fixture.
open_questions: D1: UX/architecture refine the exact supported alternative mode/settings menu and ownership; nonblocking, no provider-list decision requested now.
Q4: UX visual and interaction details remain within the separate UX workflow.
Q5: Implementation/release planning selects representative environment and external-Caddy backup/upgrade prerequisites.
D2: Remaining candidate feature priorities/exclusions are not yet approved as the complete implementation scope.
assumptions: A2: Documented Compose/DNS/networking prerequisites are an acceptable setup path; routine proxy management does not require Caddy JSON expertise.
A3: Beyond confirmed audience, deployment, public HTTPS and mode choice, remaining candidate requirements/exclusions are proposals.
